statement: Background reporting carried in the same document, dated 2026-08-09, says Samsung reached golden yield in the 80% range for HBM4 by August 2026, up from below 60% when mass production began in February 2026, while NVIDIA is described as having tested Rubin Ultra prototypes and strongly considering prioritizing HBM4E 8-high or the previous-generation HBM4 because of capacity limits said to extend into 2027.
why: Samsung improving HBM4 yield adds a second qualified supplier, which loosens the single-supplier chokepoint even while total capacity stays tight into 2027.

impact.mechanism: Better Samsung yield expands alternative HBM4 supply, but the stated capacity limits into 2027 keep total memory availability the binding constraint.

evidence.source: BigGo Finance (background, 2026-08-09) as carried in the Digitimes dispatch
evidence.excerpt: Samsung achieved 'golden yield' in the 80% range for HBM4 by August 2026, up from below 60% when mass production began in February 2026

confidence.basis: Secondary background from a 2026-08-09 BigGo Finance piece with source quotes truncated mid-sentence in the document; the supporting Sammy Fans summary was not independently fetched (HTTP 403).
